method: ENGINEERING native phone HUD priority. Actor-free world, projected markers and a long firing cooldown arranged; native FIRE therefore tests focus ownership without spending rounds. Actual encounter dispatcher and ordinary paused note UI exercised. Not a played mission, human readability or FPS result.

checks.name: authored encounter advice is recorded fully while idle, without a passive tracking bar
native firing clears only secondary text and preserves components, vitals and input geometry
release grace persists in game time and paused field messages remain natively reachable
AIM uses the same focus policy and planning clears it without losing field messages
charging focus and urgent resource messages survive combat filtering
advisory history is bounded to six full entries and resets on fresh start
